gaps.sentence: The castle is ___ (SIGHT) for miles in every direction.
gaps.explanation: 'Be visible' = can be seen; 'visibility' is the noun for how far you can see.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the delegation was delayed by the storm.
Her ___ (APPOINT) as captain surprised no one.
gaps.explanation: 'Her appointment as captain' — the event of being appointed.

gaps.sentence: The project was abandoned for ___ (FINANCE) reasons.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'reasons': financial.

gaps.sentence: With careful ___ (PREPARE), the trek is perfectly safe.
The refugees celebrated their ___ (FREE) at last.
She showed great ___ (WISE) in avoiding the deal.
gaps.explanation: 'Wisdom' — the quality noun from wise (spelling: wise → wisdom).
